resources.string: Your saved readings are still on this phone. Continue where you stopped.
Enter a number in mmHg (up to 32 characters).
This reading is already saved on this phone.
There is no correction to undo.
The sitting will close and remain available for review.
The number is too long. Use up to 32 characters.
The reading could not be saved. Your entry is still here. Try again.
The correction could not be saved. Your changes are still here. Try again.
The draft could not be restored. Saved readings are still available. Choose an eye to continue.
The sitting could not be updated. Try again.
Readings stay on this phone. Aloeil does not upload them automatically. The file provider you choose may sync your encrypted backup.
Choose a passphrase of at least 12 characters. Keep it separately; the file cannot be restored without it.
Keep the backup file and its passphrase separately. The file includes your reading history.
Choose an Aloeil backup file and enter its passphrase. Nothing changes until you confirm.
Restore adds missing readings. Readings already on this phone are kept.
%1$d new readings added. Existing readings were kept.
Use no more than 1,024 characters for the backup passphrase.
Use at least 12 characters for the backup passphrase.
Enter your passphrase again to continue with the selected file. No readings were transferred.
The backup could not be written. If a file was created, delete it before retrying.
The encrypted backup could not be prepared. Your readings are still on this phone.
The file or passphrase could not be verified. Nothing was restored.
The backup could not be restored. Readings already on this phone were kept.
If the device showed a range message, choose the matching direction. Do not estimate a number.
This removes the reading and its correction history from this phone. Older backup files may still contain it. Keep or delete those files separately.
Older backup files may still contain this reading. A new backup includes a marker that prevents older files from restoring it here.
The reading could not be deleted. Try again.
This backup also contains %1$d deleted reading markers. They prevent old files from restoring those readings; this restore will not delete a reading already on this phone.
History could not be loaded. Try again.
YYYY-MM-DD; dates use each reading’s recorded time zone.
Enter valid dates in YYYY-MM-DD order. No date filter was applied.
%1$d device range states appear in the list only.
There are no numeric readings to graph.
Left eye: %1$d circular points. Right eye: %2$d square points.
Numeric reading graph. Left eye uses circles; right eye uses squares. The exact readings and times are in the list below.
From %1$s to %2$s in phone time zone %3$s.
Points recorded at the same time and value can overlap. The list includes every reading.
The original time zone was not recorded in this older reading; time is shown in UTC.
More than 2,000 numeric readings match. Narrow the dates to view the graph; the list remains complete.

The phone cannot read its encrypted local data. Nothing has been deleted. If you have an Aloeil encrypted backup and its passphrase, you can reset this unreadable local copy and then restore the backup. Without a backup, the local readings may not be recoverable.
Keep the backup file and passphrase separately. You can leave this screen without resetting.

This permanently deletes this phone’s Aloeil database, including readings, drafts and deletion markers. It does not delete backup files you saved elsewhere. After reset, choose “Back up or restore” to import an encrypted archive.
The local reset did not finish. No backup was imported. Try again or leave the app.
